svg.text: Ranking and default delivery on three datasets: Hit@5, delivered hit, items per question
Every system at its default settings; only configurations without a language model that exist in all three sources are listed. Own question set: 120 answerable questions.
Left out: dsh-fish-memory (PerLTQA, LoCoMo); lingshu (LoCoMo). On that dataset they stored over 5% fewer memories than they were sent; see the write audit in the
bench/external/results/summary.md · PerLTQA 32 stores, 8,588 questions; LoCoMo 10 stores, 1,535 questions · 2026-11-27
